title: First‑Run Quickstart: Compact Illustration & Microcopy Kit for Console Orientation
creator: Monica Alvarez
description: Produce a compact visual & microcopy asset kit for the Console first‑run experience that can be used across: first‑run checklist, empty states, contextual tips, and the guided tour overlays. The goal is to reduce cognitive load on new users (esp. engineers evaluating Redwood), make actions discoverable, and ensure assets are small and easy to ship in the product build.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Figma file with 18 unique illustrations (icons + 3 hero glyphs) exported as SVG and PNG at 2x
A2: Microcopy set (headlines, 1‑line descriptions, button text) for 6 onboarding states vetted by PM and UX writing
A3: Component screenshots (desktop & tablet) for: checklist modal, empty model catalog, tips popover, and start flow banner
A4: Accessibility check: color contrast for illustrations and text >= 4.5:1 for body text, alt text provided for each asset
A5: Delivery doc with implementation notes, storybook snippets, and localization keys ready for engineering handoff
steps: Kickoff with PM + Eng to align on supported breakpoints and export formats
Create low‑fi sketches and microcopy variants for A/B test
Iterate with UX writing for tone: concise, engineer‑friendly, action focused
Produce hi‑fi assets in Figma; export and annotate alt text and usage guidelines
Run accessibility review and finalize color/contrast adjustments
Package assets, write implementation notes, and hand off to frontend for integration
feedback: 2025-02-20: Priya - prefer 3 concise CTA options instead of 5; want a path for both Try and Configure flows
2025-02-25: Andre - requested optimised SVGs with < 6KB per icon and explicit fill colors for tokenization
2025-02-28: UX Writing review - suggested shortening checklist items to 6 words max; provided tone examples
2025-03-02: Accessibility audit - flagged contrast on 'muted' blue illustration variant; designer adjusted palette
notes_for_engineering: Use exported SVGs with no embedded styles; prefer CSS variables for color overrides
Provide a single sprite for small icons and separate files for 3 hero glyphs
Microcopy keys provided in attachments should map 1:1 to i18n keys (see Confluence link)
Include sample storybook knobs for toggling 'empty' vs 'populated' states
